summary.sw: Jisajili kupata Namba ya Utambulisho (NIN) na Kitambulisho cha Taifa, fahamu NIN yako au fuatilia ombi.
summary.en: Register for a National ID Number (NIN) and National ID card, look up your NIN or track an application.

documents.sw: Cheti cha kuzaliwa (lazima kwa waliozaliwa 1980 na baadaye; kabla ya 1980 cheti au kiapo)
documents.en: Birth certificate (required if born 1980 or later; before 1980, a certificate or affidavit)

documents.sw: Nyaraka nyingine za kuthibitisha uraia kama zinavyoorodheshwa na NIDA
documents.en: Other citizenship documents as listed by NIDA

documents.sw: Barua pepe inayofanya kazi kwa usajili wa mtandaoni
documents.en: A working email address for online registration

steps.sw: Fungua NIDA Online (eonline.nida.go.tz) na ujisajili kwa barua pepe yako.
steps.en: Open NIDA Online (eonline.nida.go.tz) and sign up with your email.

steps.sw: Fungua kiunga ulichotumiwa kwenye barua pepe ili kukamilisha usajili wa akaunti.
steps.en: Open the link sent to your email to finish creating the account.

steps.sw: Jaza fomu ya maombi na upakie nyaraka (PDF ukurasa mmoja au JPG/PNG).
steps.en: Fill in the application and upload documents (single-page PDF or JPG/PNG).

steps.sw: Chapisha fomu ya maombi.
steps.en: Print the application form.

steps.sw: Peleka fomu na nyaraka halisi ofisi ya NIDA ya wilaya kwa alama za vidole na picha.
steps.en: Take the form and original documents to the NIDA district office for fingerprints and photo.

steps.sw: Fuatilia ombi lako kupitia huduma ya 'Fuatilia Ombi' au 'Fahamu NIN'.
steps.en: Track your application with 'Fuatilia Ombi' or look up your NIN with 'Fahamu NIN'.

feeNote.sw: NIDA inasema usajili wa raia una njia mbili (mtandaoni na kawaida). Kwa kitambulisho kilichopotea kuna 'gharama kidogo' inayolipwa kwa control number kupitia 'Malipo Kimtandao'; kiasi hakijaonyeshwa kwenye ukurasa wa mwanzo.
feeNote.en: NIDA says citizen registration is online or in person. Replacing a lost ID carries a 'small cost' paid by control number via 'Malipo Kimtandao'; the amount is not shown on the home page.

summary.sw: Omba pasipoti ya kielektroniki mtandaoni, kisha peleka fomu ofisi ya Uhamiaji.
summary.en: Apply online for an e-passport, then take the form to an Immigration office.

documents.sw: Cheti cha kuzaliwa cha mwombaji
documents.en: Applicant's birth certificate

documents.sw: Cheti/kiapo cha kuzaliwa cha mzazi
documents.en: Parent's birth certificate or affidavit

documents.sw: Kitambulisho cha Taifa
documents.en: National ID

documents.sw: Picha ya hivi karibuni yenye mandharinyuma ya buluu hafifu
documents.en: Recent photo with light blue background

documents.sw: Ushahidi wa safari au shughuli unayofanya
documents.en: Proof of travel or of your occupation

steps.sw: Fungua e-Immigration na uchague 'Ombi Jipya' (au ENDELEZA OMBI kama ulishaanza).
steps.en: Open e-Immigration and choose 'Ombi Jipya' (or continue an existing application).

steps.sw: Chagua aina ya ombi: mpya, imejaa/imeisha muda, imepotea au imeharibika.
steps.en: Choose the application type: new, full/expired, lost or damaged.

steps.sw: Jaza taarifa zako, wadhamini na watu wa kuwasiliana nao; hifadhi Application ID.
steps.en: Enter your details, referees and emergency contacts; save the Application ID.

steps.sw: Pakia vielelezo vyote, hakiki na uwasilishe.
steps.en: Upload all documents, review and submit.

steps.sw: Lipa ada ya fomu kwa control number, kisha chapisha fomu.
steps.en: Pay the form fee with the control number, then print the form.

steps.sw: Peleka fomu na vielelezo ofisi ya Uhamiaji iliyo karibu; ukishahakikiwa lipa ada ya pasipoti na utoe alama za vidole.
steps.en: Take the form and documents to the nearest Immigration office; after verification pay the passport fee and give fingerprints.

label.sw: Pasipoti ya kawaida: jumla ndani ya nchi (20,000 + 130,000)

summary.sw: Omba TIN ya mtu binafsi mtandaoni kupitia TRA Taxpayer Portal ukitumia NIN.
summary.en: Apply online for an individual TIN on the TRA Taxpayer Portal using your NIN.

documents.sw: Kitambulisho rasmi: Kitambulisho cha Taifa, pasipoti au kadi ya mpiga kura
documents.en: Official ID: National ID, passport or voter ID

documents.sw: Namba ya simu inayopokea SMS (OTP)
documents.en: A phone number that receives SMS (OTP)

documents.sw: Kwa TIN ya biashara: barua ya serikali ya mtaa na mkataba wa pango au hati ya eneo
documents.en: For a business TIN: a local government letter and a lease or title for the premises

steps.sw: Fungua TRA Taxpayer Portal na ubofye 'Apply for TIN'.
steps.en: Open the TRA Taxpayer Portal and click 'Apply for TIN'.

steps.sw: Weka NIN na namba ya simu.
steps.en: Enter your NIN and phone number.

steps.sw: Jaza fomu ya TIN (isiyo ya biashara au ya biashara) na uwasilishe.
steps.en: Complete the TIN form (non-business or business) and submit.

steps.sw: Weka OTP uliyotumiwa kwa SMS.
steps.en: Enter the OTP sent by SMS.

steps.sw: Utapokea SMS yenye TIN na nenosiri.
steps.en: You receive an SMS with your TIN and password.

steps.sw: Kwa TIN ya biashara, TRA itakufanyia mahojiano ya tathmini ya kodi.
steps.en: For a business TIN, TRA will hold a tax assessment interview.

feeNote.sw: Hatujathibitisha ada kwenye tovuti rasmi. Angalia kiasi kwenye namba ya malipo (control number) au ukurasa rasmi kabla ya kulipa.
feeNote.en: We have not verified a fee on the official site. Check the amount on your control number or the official page before paying.

title.sw: Sajili jina la biashara au kampuni (BRELA)
title.en: Register a business name or company (BRELA)

summary.sw: Sajili jina la biashara au kampuni mtandaoni kupitia BRELA ORS.
summary.en: Register a business name or company online with BRELA ORS.

documents.sw: Kitambulisho cha Taifa (NIN) cha wamiliki/wakurugenzi
documents.en: National ID (NIN) of owners/directors

documents.sw: Fomu zilizosainiwa zinazotakiwa na ORS (mf. consolidated form)
documents.en: Signed forms required by ORS (e.g. consolidated form)

documents.sw: Kwa kampuni: katiba (memorandum na articles)
documents.en: For a company: memorandum and articles of association

steps.sw: Fungua akaunti kwenye BRELA ORS na uiamilishe.
steps.en: Create and activate an account on BRELA ORS.

steps.sw: Ingia, chagua 'New e-service' kisha Business Name au Company.
steps.en: Log in, choose 'New e-service', then Business Name or Company.

steps.sw: Jaza fomu na taarifa za wamiliki/wakurugenzi/wanahisa.
steps.en: Complete the form with owner/director/shareholder details.

steps.sw: Pakia fomu zilizosainiwa na nyaraka zinazohitajika.
steps.en: Upload the signed forms and required documents.

steps.sw: Lipa kwa control number; ombi linawasilishwa baada ya malipo.
steps.en: Pay with the control number; the application is submitted after payment.

feeNote.sw: Hatujathibitisha ada kwenye tovuti rasmi. Angalia kiasi kwenye namba ya malipo (control number) au ukurasa rasmi kabla ya kulipa.
feeNote.en: We have not verified a fee on the official site. Check the amount on your control number or the official page before paying.

summary.sw: Omba cheti kipya cha kuzaliwa au kifo, badilisha cheti cha zamani au hakiki cheti kupitia eRITA.
summary.en: Apply for a new birth or death certificate, replace an old one or verify a certificate on eRITA.

documents.sw: Taarifa ya kuzaliwa ya mtoto (notification) iliyoskaniwa
documents.en: Scanned birth notification of the child

documents.sw: Taarifa za wazazi
documents.en: Parents' details

steps.sw: Ingia eRITA, chagua lugha na ujisajili kupata akaunti.
steps.en: Open eRITA, choose a language and register an account.

steps.sw: Chagua Birth Services kisha 'New certificate'.
steps.en: Choose Birth Services, then 'New certificate'.

steps.sw: Jaza taarifa za mtoto kwa usahihi na ambatisha notification.
steps.en: Enter the child's details correctly and attach the notification.

steps.sw: Mfumo utatoa control number; lipa kupitia mitandao ya simu (huduma za serikali).
steps.en: The system issues a control number; pay via mobile money (government services).

steps.sw: Rudi kwenye akaunti yako: ukiona 'approved' au 'issued', cheti kiko tayari.
steps.en: Check your account: 'approved' or 'issued' means the certificate is ready.

label.sw: Ombi la cheti cha kuzaliwa mtandaoni (eRITA)
Marekebisho ya cheti cha kuzaliwa (ombi likikubaliwa)
Watoto chini ya miaka 5 katika mikoa inayotekeleza mpango

feeNote.sw: Ada ya cheti cha kifo haikuonekana wazi kwenye ukurasa tuliokagua; angalia control number yako.
feeNote.en: We could not confirm the death certificate fee on the page we checked; check your control number.

summary.sw: Omba, huisha au pata nakala ya leseni ya udereva kupitia mfumo wa TRA (IDRAS).
summary.en: Apply for, renew or replace a driving licence through TRA's system (IDRAS).

documents.sw: TIN au NIN
documents.en: TIN or NIN

documents.sw: Leseni ya zamani (kwa kuhuisha)
documents.en: Old licence (for renewal)

documents.sw: Cheti cha mafunzo ya udereva/uthibitisho wa umahiri kwa leseni mpya
documents.en: Driving school / competence evidence for a new licence

steps.sw: Fungua tovuti ya TRA na uende sehemu ya Taxpayer Portal / IDRAS.
steps.en: Open the TRA website and go to Taxpayer Portal / IDRAS.

steps.sw: Chagua huduma ya Driving Licence na aina ya ombi (mpya, kuhuisha, nakala).
steps.en: Choose Driving Licence and the application type (new, renewal, duplicate).

steps.sw: Jaza taarifa na uwasilishe.
steps.en: Fill in your details and submit.

steps.sw: Chapisha taarifa ya malipo (payment notice) na ulipe kwa control number.
steps.en: Print the payment notice and pay with the control number.

steps.sw: Fuata maelekezo ya TRA kuhusu kuchukua leseni.
steps.en: Follow TRA's instructions for collecting the licence.

feeNote.sw: Hatujathibitisha ada kwenye tovuti rasmi. Angalia kiasi kwenye namba ya malipo (control number) au ukurasa rasmi kabla ya kulipa.
feeNote.en: We have not verified a fee on the official site. Check the amount on your control number or the official page before paying.

title.sw: Ardhi: kodi ya pango na milki

summary.sw: Pata makadirio na lipa kodi ya pango la ardhi, na huduma za milki kupitia e-Ardhi.
summary.en: Get a land rent assessment and pay it, and use title services through e-Ardhi.

documents.sw: Namba ya kiwanja/hati
documents.en: Plot or title number

documents.sw: Namba ya simu kwa OTP
documents.en: Phone number for OTP

steps.sw: Kwa kodi ya pango, fungua landrent.lands.go.tz; kwa mikoa iliyohamia, utaelekezwa e-Ardhi.
steps.en: For land rent, open landrent.lands.go.tz; regions already migrated are directed to e-Ardhi.

steps.sw: Ingia e-Ardhi kwa OTP kisha weka jina la mtumiaji na nenosiri.
steps.en: Sign in to e-Ardhi with an OTP, then set a username and password.

steps.sw: Tafuta kiwanja chako na upate makadirio (bili) ya kodi.
steps.en: Find your plot and get the rent assessment (bill).

steps.sw: Lipa kwa control number.
steps.en: Pay with the control number.

feeNote.sw: Kodi ya pango hukadiriwa kwa kila kiwanja; Lango haionyeshi kiasi.
feeNote.en: Land rent is assessed per plot; Lango does not show an amount.

summary.sw: Jisajili au simamia uanachama wa NHIF, ikiwemo Toto Afya Kadi kwa watoto.
summary.en: Register for or manage NHIF membership, including Toto Afya Kadi for children.

documents.sw: Kitambulisho cha Taifa
documents.en: National ID

documents.sw: Namba ya simu au barua pepe kwa OTP
documents.en: Phone or email for OTP

documents.sw: Kwa Toto Afya: nyaraka zilizoorodheshwa na NHIF (mf. cheti cha kuzaliwa)
documents.en: For Toto Afya: documents listed by NHIF (e.g. birth certificate)

steps.sw: Fungua NHIF Self Service na uchague kujisajili.
steps.en: Open NHIF Self Service and choose to register.

steps.sw: Weka taarifa zinazoombwa na thibitisha kwa OTP.
steps.en: Enter the requested details and confirm with the OTP.

steps.sw: Chagua kifurushi (mf. Toto Afya) na usome masharti yake kwenye tovuti ya NHIF.
steps.en: Choose a package (e.g. Toto Afya) and read its terms on the NHIF site.

steps.sw: Lipa mchango kwa control number utakayopewa.
steps.en: Pay the contribution with the control number you are given.

feeNote.sw: Michango hutegemea kifurushi. Angalia ukurasa rasmi wa NHIF kwa viwango vya sasa.
feeNote.en: Contributions depend on the package. See NHIF's official pages for current rates.

summary.sw: Angalia michango yako na upate taarifa (statement) kupitia NSSF Portal au app ya NSSF Taarifa.
summary.en: Check your contributions and get a statement on the NSSF Portal or NSSF Taarifa app.

documents.sw: Namba ya uanachama NSSF
documents.en: NSSF membership number

documents.sw: Namba ya simu uliyosajilia NSSF
documents.en: The phone number registered with NSSF

steps.sw: Usajili wa mwanachama mara nyingi hufanyika kupitia mwajiri katika ofisi za NSSF.
steps.en: Member registration is normally done through your employer at NSSF offices.

steps.sw: Fungua NSSF Portal na uingie kwa namba yako ya simu iliyosajiliwa.
steps.en: Open the NSSF Portal and sign in with your registered phone number.

steps.sw: Angalia michango na pakua statement.
steps.en: View contributions and download a statement.

steps.sw: Kama namba ya simu hailingani, isasishe ofisi ya NSSF iliyo karibu.
steps.en: If your phone number doesn't match, update it at a nearby NSSF office.

feeNote.sw: Hakuna ada iliyoonyeshwa kwa kuangalia michango.
feeNote.en: No fee is listed for checking contributions.

summary.sw: Omba mkopo wa elimu ya juu kupitia mfumo wa OLAMS wa HESLB.
summary.en: Apply for a higher education loan through HESLB's OLAMS system.

documents.sw: Kitambulisho cha Taifa (NIN)
documents.en: National ID (NIN)

documents.sw: Cheti cha kuzaliwa kilichohakikiwa na RITA
documents.en: Birth certificate verified by RITA

documents.sw: Namba za mitihani (CSEE/ACSEE au sawa na hizo)
documents.en: Exam numbers (CSEE/ACSEE or equivalent)

documents.sw: Nyaraka nyingine kama zinavyoelekezwa kwenye mwongozo wa mwaka husika
documents.en: Other documents as listed in that year's guidelines

steps.sw: Soma mwongozo wa mwaka husika kwenye tovuti ya HESLB.
steps.en: Read that year's guidelines on the HESLB website.

steps.sw: Fungua OLAMS na ufungue akaunti.
steps.en: Open OLAMS and create an account.

steps.sw: Lipa ada ya maombi kwa control number inayotolewa na mfumo pekee.
steps.en: Pay the application fee using only the system-generated control number.

steps.sw: Jaza fomu, pakia nyaraka na uwasilishe kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho.
steps.en: Complete the form, upload documents and submit before the deadline.

steps.sw: Fuatilia hali ya ombi kwenye akaunti yako ya OLAMS.
steps.en: Track the status in your OLAMS account.

label.sw: Ada ya maombi, shahada ya kwanza 2026/2027 (hairudishwi)

feeNote.sw: Dirisha la maombi 2026/2027 lilikuwa 19 Juni hadi 31 Agosti 2026. Hakiki tarehe mpya kwenye HESLB.
feeNote.en: The 2026/2027 window ran 19 June to 31 August 2026. Check HESLB for new dates.

summary.sw: Angalia matokeo ya CSEE (kidato cha nne), ACSEE (kidato cha sita) na mitihani mingine.
summary.en: Check CSEE (Form Four), ACSEE (Form Six) and other exam results.

documents.sw: Namba ya mtahiniwa na jina la kituo/shule
documents.en: Candidate number and centre/school name

steps.sw: Fungua ukurasa wa matokeo wa NECTA.
steps.en: Open NECTA's results page.

steps.sw: Chagua mtihani (mf. CSEE au ACSEE) na mwaka.
steps.en: Choose the exam (e.g. CSEE or ACSEE) and year.

steps.sw: Tafuta kituo/shule yako kwenye orodha.
steps.en: Find your centre/school in the list.

steps.sw: Tafuta namba yako ya mtahiniwa kuona matokeo.
steps.en: Find your candidate number to see the results.

feeNote.sw: Kuangalia matokeo mtandaoni hakuna ada iliyoonyeshwa.
feeNote.en: No fee is listed for viewing results online.

summary.sw: Nunua LUKU kwa simu au benki, na omba kuunganishiwa umeme kupitia NIKONEKT.
summary.en: Buy LUKU by mobile money or bank, and apply for a new connection on NIKONEKT.

documents.sw: Namba ya mita (kwa LUKU)
documents.en: Meter number (for LUKU)

documents.sw: Kitambulisho na taarifa za eneo/nyumba (kwa kuunganishiwa)
documents.en: ID and property details (for a connection)

steps.sw: LUKU: tumia menyu ya malipo ya mtandao wako wa simu au benki, weka namba ya mita na kiasi; utapokea tokeni.
steps.en: LUKU: use your mobile money or bank payments menu, enter the meter number and amount; you receive a token.

steps.sw: Weka tokeni kwenye mita yako.
steps.en: Enter the token on your meter.

steps.sw: Kuunganishiwa: fungua NIKONEKT na uchague 'New Application'.
steps.en: New connection: open NIKONEKT and choose 'New Application'.

steps.sw: Jaza matumizi, kundi, aina ya mwombaji na kitambulisho, kisha taarifa za eneo.
steps.en: Enter purpose, category, applicant type and ID, then the property details.

steps.sw: Fuatilia ombi kwa namba ya ombi na namba ya simu.
steps.en: Track it with your application number and phone number.

feeNote.sw: Gharama za kuunganishiwa hutolewa na TANESCO baada ya ombi; Lango haionyeshi kiasi.
feeNote.en: Connection costs are quoted by TANESCO after you apply; Lango does not show an amount.

summary.sw: Lipa bili ya maji kwa control number na omba huduma ya maji Dar es Salaam. Mikoa mingine: mamlaka ya maji ya eneo lako.
summary.en: Pay water bills with a control number and apply for water in Dar es Salaam. Other regions: your local water authority.

documents.sw: Bili yenye control number (huanza na 99104)
documents.en: Bill with control number (starts 99104)

documents.sw: Kwa kuunganishiwa: fomu ya maombi na nyaraka za umiliki
documents.en: For a connection: application form and ownership documents

steps.sw: Pata control number kwenye bili au SMS baada ya kusomwa mita.
steps.en: Find the control number on your bill or the SMS after meter reading.

steps.sw: Lipa kupitia simu, benki au njia za malipo ya serikali.
steps.en: Pay through mobile money, bank or government payment channels.

steps.sw: Kuunganishiwa: jaza fomu ya DAWASA na ambatisha nyaraka za umiliki.
steps.en: Connection: fill in the DAWASA form and attach ownership documents.

steps.sw: DAWASA watapima eneo na kukupa makadirio ya gharama.
steps.en: DAWASA surveys the site and quotes the cost.

feeNote.sw: Gharama za kuunganishiwa hukadiriwa baada ya kupima eneo.
feeNote.en: Connection costs are quoted after the site survey.

summary.sw: Wasilisha malalamiko, maoni, maulizo au pongezi kwa taasisi za umma na ufuatilie majibu.
summary.en: Send complaints, suggestions, questions or praise to public institutions and track the reply.

documents.sw: Maelezo ya tatizo na taasisi husika
documents.en: A description of the issue and the institution

steps.sw: Fungua tovuti ya e-Mrejesho au app ya e-Mrejesho.
steps.en: Open the e-Mrejesho website or app.

steps.sw: Au piga *152*00#, chagua 9 kisha 2 na ufuate maelekezo.
steps.en: Or dial *152*00#, choose 9 then 2 and follow the prompts.

steps.sw: Chagua taasisi, aina ya mrejesho na eleza tatizo.
steps.en: Choose the institution and feedback type and describe the issue.

steps.sw: Hifadhi namba ya kumbukumbu kufuatilia jibu.
steps.en: Keep the reference number to track the reply.

summary.sw: Namba za bure za dharura: Polisi 112, Zimamoto 114, Gari la wagonjwa 115.
summary.en: Free emergency numbers: Police 112, Fire 114, Ambulance 115.

steps.sw: Piga 112 kwa dharura au Polisi.
steps.en: Call 112 for emergencies or Police.

steps.sw: Piga 114 kwa moto, 115 kwa gari la wagonjwa.
steps.en: Call 114 for fire, 115 for an ambulance.

steps.sw: Mali iliyopotea: tumia mfumo wa Polisi wa LORMIS kwenye tovuti ya Polisi.
steps.en: Lost property: use the Police LORMIS system on the Police website.

steps.sw: Hati ya tabia njema (PCC): tumia huduma ya PCC kwenye tovuti ya Polisi.
steps.en: Police clearance (PCC): use the PCC service on the Police website.

summary.sw: Lipa ada au bili yoyote ya serikali kwa control number kupitia simu, benki au app ya GePG.
summary.en: Pay any government fee or bill with a control number via mobile money, bank or the GePG app.

documents.sw: Control number kutoka kwa taasisi inayokudai
documents.en: The control number from the institution billing you

steps.sw: Pata control number kutoka kwa taasisi (mfano NIDA, Uhamiaji, RITA).
steps.en: Get a control number from the institution (e.g. NIDA, Immigration, RITA).

steps.sw: Kwenye simu chagua huduma za serikali/malipo ya serikali, au tumia GePG portal/app.
steps.en: On your phone choose government payments, or use the GePG portal/app.

steps.sw: Weka control number, hakiki jina la taasisi na kiasi, kisha lipa.
steps.en: Enter the control number, check the institution and amount, then pay.

steps.sw: Hifadhi risiti. Usipopata control number, wasiliana kwanza na taasisi husika.
steps.en: Keep the receipt. If you didn't get a control number, contact the institution first.

feeNote.sw: Kiasi kinaamuliwa na taasisi iliyotoa control number.
feeNote.en: The amount is set by the institution that issued the control number.

name.sw: Makao Makuu NIDA, Barabara ya Kilimani, Dar es Salaam
name.en: NIDA HQ, Kilimani Road, Dar es Salaam

note.sw: Usajili hukamilishwa ofisi ya NIDA ya wilaya yako.
note.en: Registration is completed at your district NIDA office.

name.sw: RITA Tower, 4 Mtaa wa Simu, Dar es Salaam
name.en: RITA Tower, 4 Simu Street, Dar es Salaam

note.sw: Ofisi za wilaya hushughulikia usajili wa vizazi.
Ofisi za TRA zipo kila mkoa; tafuta ya karibu kwenye tovuti ya TRA.
note.en: TRA has offices in every region; find the nearest on the TRA website.
